subject: BCP/DR evidence: RTO/RPO traces + on-call witness availability
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cypressbank.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security-questions@cypressbank.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and witness for DR acceptance

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for taking the time on yesterday's SIG call. As part of our third-party resilience assessment we need some concrete artifacts and a short witness session with your ops team. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday?

- A short extract (10–15 min) of an RTO exercise trace that demonstrates failover + warm cache behavior. Prefer raw logs or a short trace file.
- RTO and RPO attestation table for the last 12 months (high level is fine).
- Your on-call rotation calendar and name of the person(s) available to join a 30-minute witness session the week of May 25–29.
- Any short playbook excerpt that covers warm-start / prefix-cache rehydration for serving.

We may need a follow-up live witness where our reviewers watch a replay and ask a few clarifying questions. If possible, include an internal contact who can answer questions about escalation and runbook steps.

Appreciate it — Olivia

Olivia Chen
Senior Third-Party Risk Analyst
Cypress Bank
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cypressbank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and witness for DR acceptance

Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick plan and ask: 

1) Attached you'll find: Redwood_DR_Playbook_v2.pdf (excerpted section: Warm cache & cold-start playbook), and a condensed RTO/RPO attestation table for the trailing 12 months.

2) Warm cache trace: we will provide a sanitized trace file (warm-cache-trace-20260508.txt) that includes timestamps and high-level markers for cache warm, prefix-set restore, and request latency before/after. Because the trace contains internal hostnames and token hashes, Ben will sanitize and produce a redacted version by EOD Thursday.

3) On-call witness: our on-call rotation for SRE is attached (oncall_rotation_2026q2.csv). Suggested attendees for the witness session: Marissa Cole (Director, Customer Reliability) and Akash Reddy (SRE lead) — Akash will run the replay and answer escalation/runbook questions. Marissa is copying Akash into our internal calendar after we confirm the slot.

4) Logistics: we can offer two 30-minute windows for the week of May 25–29 (live via Zoom): Tuesday 05/26 10:00–10:30 PT or Thursday 05/28 14:00–14:30 PT. Please confirm preferred slot and whether you prefer a recording only or live Q&A.

We will also surface our fallback policy (model variant downgrade and fallback routing) and a brief note on recovery SLA measurement during the session.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
SRE Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and witness for DR acceptance

Checking in to confirm I can join the witness. Ben — can you finalize the redaction pass on the trace and drop the sanitized file into the shared DR folder? Also, I'll prepare a 1-page runbook excerpt that explains the warm-start steps and verification checks (health probes, cache-hit thresholds, and verification plan).

Ben — suggested redaction checklist: strip hostnames, remove raw token hashes, replace internal IPs with region tags (e.g., us-west-2-node-1 -> {region}-node-#), and keep timing/elapsed fields. If you hit anything that looks like customer data, escalate to legal immediately.

I will also add a section in the playbook extract that lists escalation contacts and the RTO measurement method we use (90% tile of successful prefix restores within X minutes).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cypressbank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, security-questions@cypressbank.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and witness for DR acceptance

Olivia — sending the items we promised. Attachments included: Redwood_DR_Playbook_v2.pdf (excerpts: sections 3.2–3.5 on warm start), oncall_rotation_2026q2.csv, warm-cache-trace-20260508.txt (sanitized by Ben). High level notes below: 

- RTO/RPO attestation: our measured RTO for cross-region failovers (last 12 months) — median 6 min, 95th 12 min; RPO measured at near-zero for stateful KV caches due to continuous prefix syncing (typical RPO < 30s). Table included in playbook excerpt.

- Warm-cache behavior: the attached trace shows cold period, prefix rehydration, and latency impact on a 1M token workload. Key markers: cache-init (00:00:12), prefix-apply (00:00:45), validation probes green at 00:02:10.

- Witness session: we can host live Q&A on Thursday 05/28 14:00–14:30 PT. Attendees: Marissa Cole (runs runbook walk), Akash Reddy (SRE lead, handles replay), Ben Carter (security redaction and artifact owner). If you confirm, we'll send a calendar invite and Zoom link.

Let me know if you need any additional documentation (e.g., CloudTrail extracts or audit log slices).

Thanks — Jonas

Attachments: Redwood_DR_Playbook_v2.pdf (excerpt), oncall_rotation_2026q2.csv, warm-cache-trace-20260508.txt
